column1: # Brown (1973) Table 1 - IMP-6 Galactic Radio Spectrum
# Source: ApJ 180
# Instrument: IMP-6 (Explorer 43)
# Pointing: Minimum galactic radiation
# Brightness units: W m^-2 Hz^-1 sr^-1 (converted from x10^-23 as tabulated)
# All errors are in percent (%)
# Error components:
#   err_power_pct     : Group I  - absolute power level calibration
#   err_impedance_pct : Group II - dipole reception & transmission
#   err_total_power_pct: Total power error (Groups I+II combined in quadrature)
#   err_rms_recv_pct  : Group III - RMS receiving system noise fluctuations
#   err_rms_orbital_pct: Group IV - RMS orbital average fluctuation
#   err_total_fluct_pct: Total fluctuation error (Groups III+IV combined in quadrature)
#   err_total_pct     : Total error (all groups combined in quadrature)
# Notes:
#   - Minimum spectrum: lowest emission observed
#   - NOT a galactic pole measurement; complementary to Novaco & Brown (1978) NGP/SGP
#   - Brown 1973 does not appear in Cane (1979) observer list
#     is a minimum/ecliptic spectrum rather than a polar spectrum
#   - Calibration: CW method below 700 kHz
#   - Data from orbits 10-40 after full 300-ft antenna deployment
